newsitem.title: USA: AMF Bowling to acquire American Recreation.
newsitem.headline: AMF Bowling to acquire American Recreation.

text.p: AMF Bowling Worldwide said on Friday it aggreed to acquire American Recreation Centers Inc for $8.50 per share in cash.

American Recreation operates 43 bowling centers in six states - California, Texas, Oklahoma, Wisconsin, Kentucky and Missouri. For the year ended May 29, 1996, it had revenues of $46.1 million, it said. AMF Bowling owns and operates 342 bowling centers in 11 countries.
After reflecting the assumption of American Recreation's outstanding debt and the purchase of certain joint venture interests, the total transaction value was about $70 million, the company said.
The boards of directors of both companies unanimously approved the merger but it was still certain conditions. It was expected to close in the second quarter, AMF said.
